from enum import Enum, auto

class TokenType(Enum):
    # Literals
    NUMBER = auto()
    STRING = auto()
    IDENT = auto()
    
    # Keywords
    PRINT = auto()
    IF = auto()
    ELSE = auto()
    WHILE = auto()
    DEF = auto()
    RETURN = auto()
    
    # Operators

    MINUS = auto()
    STAR = auto()
    SLASH = auto()
    EQ = auto()        # =
    EQ_EQ = auto()     # ==
    NOT_EQ = auto()    # !=
    LT = auto()        # <

    LT_EQ = auto()     # <=
    GT_EQ = auto()     # >=
    
    # Delimiters

    RPAREN = auto()
    COLON = auto()
    COMMA = auto()
    NEWLINE = auto()
    INDENT = auto()
    DEDENT = auto()
    EOF = auto()

class Token:
    def __init__(self, type, value=None, line=0, col=0):
        self.type = type
        self.value = value
        self.line = line
        self.col = col
    
    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Token({self.type}, {self.value!r}, line={self.line})"

KEYWORDS = {
    'print': TokenType.PRINT,
    'if': TokenType.IF,
    'else': TokenType.ELSE,
    'while': TokenType.WHILE,
    'def': TokenType.DEF,
    'return': TokenType.RETURN,
}

        self.source = source
        self.filename = filename
        self.pos = 0
        self.line = 1
        self.col = 1
        self.indent_stack = [0]  # Start at indent level 0
        self.tokens = []
        self._tokenize()
    
    def _tokenize(self):
        while self.pos < len(self.source):
            c = self._peek()
            if c == '\n':
                self._handle_newline()
                self._advance()
            elif c in ' \t\r':
                self._advance()
            elif c == '#':

                    self._advance()
                    self._add_token(TokenType.LT_EQ, '<=')

                if self._peek() == '=':
                    self._advance()
                    self._add_token(TokenType.GT_EQ, '>=')
                else:
                    self._add_token(TokenType.GT, '>')

                self._add_token(TokenType.PLUS, '+')

                self._add_token(TokenType.MINUS, '-')

                self._add_token(TokenType.STAR, '*')

            self.indent_stack.append(indent)
            self._add_token(TokenType.INDENT, '')
        elif indent < self.indent_stack[-1]:
            while self.indent_stack and indent < self.indent_stack[-1]:
                self.indent_stack.pop()
                self._add_token(TokenType.DEDENT, '')
            if indent != self.indent_stack[-1]:
                self._error(f"Inconsistent indentation (expected {self.indent_stack[-1]}, got {indent})")
    
    def _skip_comment(self):
        # Skip the # and everything until newline
        while self.pos < len(self.source) and self.source[self.pos] != '\n':
            self._advance()
    
    def _tokenize_number(self):
        start_col = self.col
        num_str = ''
        is_float = False
        while self.pos < len(self.source) and (self.source[self.pos].isdigit() or self.source[self.pos] == '.'):
            if self.source[self.pos] == '.':
                if is_float:
                    self._error("Invalid number: multiple decimal points")
                is_float = True
            num_str += self.source[self.pos]
            self._advance()
        
        if is_float:
            self._add_token(TokenType.NUMBER, float(num_str))
        else:
            self._add_token(TokenType.NUMBER, int(num_str))
    
    def _tokenize_string(self):
        quote = self.source[self.pos]
        self._advance()  # Skip opening quote
        start_col = self.col
        s = ''
        while self.pos < len(self.source) and self.source[self.pos] != quote:
            if self.source[self.pos] == '\\':
                self._advance()
                if self.pos < len(self.source):
                    c = self.source[self.pos]
                    if c == 'n': s += '\n'
                    elif c == 't': s += '\t'
                    elif c == '\\': s += '\\'
                    elif c == quote: s += quote
                    else: s += '\\' + c
            else:
                s += self.source[self.pos]
            self._advance()
        
        if self.pos >= len(self.source):
            self._error("Unterminated string literal")
        
        self._advance()  # Skip closing quote
        self._add_token(TokenType.STRING, s)
    
    def _tokenize_ident_or_keyword(self):
        ident = ''
        while self.pos < len(self.source) and (self.source[self.pos].isalnum() or self.source[self.pos] == '_'):
            ident += self.source[self.pos]
            self._advance()
        
        if ident in KEYWORDS:
            self._add_token(KEYWORDS[ident], ident)
        else:
            self._add_token(TokenType.IDENT, ident)
    
    def _peek(self):
        if self.pos < len(self.source):
            return self.source[self.pos]
        return '\0'
    
    def _advance(self):
        if self.pos < len(self.source):
            if self.source[self.pos] == '\n':
                self.line += 1
                self.col = 1
            else:
                self.col += 1
            self.pos += 1
    
    def _add_token(self, type, value):
        self.tokens.append(Token(type, value, self.line, self.col))
    
    def _error(self, msg):
        raise LexerError(f"{self.filename}:{self.line}:{self.col}: {msg}")

class LexerError(Exception):
    pass
